live_high.text: St Finbarrs to win at 1.62 (-161) is the match-winner selection against Nemo Rangers in Cork's Premier Senior Football Championship Final. live_high.text: Back KS Kielce on the money line at 1.68 (-147) in the EHF Champions League Group F match against Kolstad on Wednesday 28 October, 20:45 CET at Hala Legionow. Back Dinamo Bucuresti to win at 1.70 (-143) in Thursday night's Group E finale at FDI Stadium in Montpellier (20:45 CET). Third-placed Dinamo (1-1-3, 3 points, 134:145) remain alive for the second Main Round berth after dismantling SAH - Aarhus 37:23 on Wednesday — the biggest Champions League victory in club history — led by Victor Iturizza (5/5), Haniel Langaro, and goalkeeper Ionut Iancu, and Dinamo also won the Round 1 meeting in Bucharest. Fourth-placed Montpellier (1-0-4, 2 points, 150:165) have lost four straight and are already eliminated following Thursday's 40:34 defeat at Barca, where centre back Pol Valera noted mounting player injuries and Benjamin Richert received a direct red card. Dinamo Bucuresti to win is our selection.

live_high.text: Cucine Lube Civitanova to win the match at 1.44 (-227) is the call against Pallavolo Padova at Eurosuole Forum. Lube's opening sweep of Verona produced 78 rally points and only 65 conceded, placing them fourth in the league table with three points. Padova enter eleventh after a straight-sets defeat to Piacenza, scoring 56 points against 75. The contrast is in both attack and resistance, not simply the result column: Civitanova cleared their first test without dropping a set, whereas Padova have yet to claim one. Those opening-round figures favor Lube, though one match is too small a sample to treat this as a certainty.
